result.title: 3D Tracking Any Point with Events and Frames
result.summary: Tracking a fast-moving point in 3D is prohibitive when RGB frames are blurred or too far apart to reveal its motion. Event cameras record brightness changes between frames, providing measurements inside these temporal gaps. We introduce TrackAnyMotion, which combines monocular RGB frames and events to track arbitrary points in 2D and 3D, including at times when no RGB frame is available. The motion expected for a static point, given scene geometry and camera motion, provides a reference for identifying independently moving objects. An independent-motion decoder combines geometric motion cues with event guidance and 2D tracks, feeding its predictions back into iterative 2D and 3D refinement. We also introduce HyperEvent, a synthetic RGB--Event dataset with high-frequency 3D trajectories, geometry, and independent-motion labels. At RGB frame timestamps on this benchmark, TrackAnyMotion reduces 3D and 2D endpoint errors by 70\% and 32\%, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TrackAnyMotion，融合单目 RGB 帧与事件相机数据在 2D 与 3D 中跟踪任意点，以静态点的几何预期运动为参照识别独立运动，并将预测反馈进迭代式 2D/3D 精化，同时发布 HyperEvent 合成数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以「预期运动与实际观测的偏差」筛出独立运动、并在无 RGB 帧时用事件补充证据，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 LOOK 时机的问题；但属三维点跟踪任务，迁移性可能有限。
